versions.name: Camp Lavigne
versions.summary: A Columbia-Montour Council resident camp in the hills north of Benton in central Pennsylvania, offering a unit-centered Scouts BSA summer camp alongside Cub Scout resident and day programs and a COPE and climbing course.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Columbia-Montour Council camping page. The source's French Creek Council attribution is wrong: Camp Lavigne is a Columbia-Montour Council camp. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; camp_type/program_types classified from the council page as a Scouts BSA resident camp with Cub resident and day programs; features unsurveyed.
